look_here_first: Annual or biennial sneezeweed with winged stems and an unmistakably elongated ovoid-to-conical central disk surrounded by yellow rays.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local source; Kew accepts species as native in Texas and the southeastern/south-central U.S.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; broader exact-county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Asteraceae/Helenium: composite heads with a raised receptacle, yellow or partly darkened rays, and often winged stems from decurrent leaf bases. Habit, stem wings, disk shape/color, and ray form are high-value characters.
best_field_traits: leaves variable from broad to grasslike
disk often yellow below and yellow-brown toward tips
morphology_keys.comparison_training: The name is literal: longdisk. The elongated cone-like disk is the fastest split from the more rounded heads of H. elegans and H. autumnale.
